issues.file: set-D-01.jpg, set-D-02.jpg (crops 3, 5), set-D-03.jpg (crop 9), set-F-02.jpg (crops 3, 5), set-F-03.jpg (crops 8-10), set-E-02.jpg (crops 2, 3)
issues.where: the floor of the scene inside the globe, just above the collar
issues.what: the ground is one luminous, saturated green band of almost even value with no relief, no grass or stones breaking it, and no falloff toward the glass. It reads as a flat-coloured slab cut level across the sphere, not as fog or moss
issues.fix: break the band into moss, grass and low fog with a darker, varied value; let it thin and darken toward the glass wall, show contact shadows under the fence, tree and pumpkins, and let some fallen leaves rest on it

issues.where: the upper-left interior of the glass, near the shoulder
issues.what: long, thin, perfectly straight bright lines run across the interior. They pass in front of and behind the particles with no refraction break and no chipped edge, so they read as stray strands or render artefacts, not as cracks or scratches in the glass
issues.fix: remove them, or make them real surface scratches: short, slightly curved, sitting on the glass surface, catching the highlight only where the light hits them, and slightly bending what is seen through them

issues.where: the cobweb on the right side of the base, running down to the surface
issues.what: the web is a flat fan of straight, parallel, evenly spaced lines forming a faceted triangular sheet. There is no sag, no spiral, no droplets and no varying thickness, so it reads as geometry
issues.fix: give the web a catenary sag, a spiral capture thread, uneven strand thickness, a few broken strands and dew beads that catch the light; anchor it to a twig and to a leaf on the ground

issues.where: the fallen leaves on the surface, left and right of the base
issues.what: the leaves repeat one or two templates with the same evenly serrated sawtooth edge, are paper-thin, and have almost the same colour. Several curled leaves hover with no contact shadow or reflection seam where they meet the wet surface
issues.fix: mix species, sizes, stages of decay and colour; add curl with thickness at the stem and a dark contact line plus a short sharp reflection where each leaf touches the surface; lay the flat ones down so they look wet

issues.where: the interior just inside the rim
issues.what: the tree branches and particles run straight up to the inner wall with little compression or bending, so the liquid hardly enlarges or bends what is inside near the edge
issues.fix: add refractive compression and magnification toward the rim, so that branches near the edge bend and squeeze, with a thin band of inverted, distorted content just inside the wall

issues.where: the bats near the top of the globe
issues.what: the bats are flat black silhouettes with no rim light, no wing membrane detail and no depth blur, so they look pasted on next to the softly focused particles
issues.fix: give them a faint orange rim light from the lamp and leaf glow, some wing translucency, and match their focus to their depth

issues.where: the cream drips around the collar
issues.what: the drips have the same smooth, even gloss and an opaque cream colour with no translucency, so they read as moulded plastic rather than wax or bone
issues.fix: add subsurface translucency, a slight colour shift toward their thin tips, a tiny surface texture and run lengths that vary

issues.where: the black core of the base behind the twigs
issues.what: the core is a uniform black with a fine even stipple, which reads as foam or rubber with texture at the wrong scale
issues.fix: make it dark carved wood or iron with a soft sheen and edge wear, or fill the gaps with darker twigs so the core is not visible

issues.where: the surface just right of the base
issues.what: small pale flat splats lie on the surface like stamped decals, with no thickness and no reflection
issues.fix: remove them or make them real wax drops with a rounded meniscus, a highlight and a reflection

issues.where: the pond area inside the globe
issues.what: set D has no visible pond; the area meant for it is the flat green ground, so the water cannot be judged
issues.fix: add the pond with a dark, reflective surface that picks up the lamp, as in set F
